normalized_proposition_en: Retrieval, generation, policy evaluation and reviewer decisions are separate records.
Every request binds an authenticated principal and tenant.
Authorized overrides require elevated role, a secondary reviewer and audited reason
Tokens carry issuer, audience, expiry, subject and tenant
empty-page ratio, unknown-character ratio, table-loss indicators, language confidence
Failed index writes do not roll back accepted metadata
Citation click opens source and highlights anchored page range.
Source deletion tombstones and schedules index removal.
Present exact artifact, citations, model/prompt version and policy reasons.
Final response pointer and satisfied gate commit atomically
replay cannot publish another artifact under old approval.
Actor/request-fingerprint outcomes are retained for 24 hours
single Admin export fails the two-person control.
Typical `1 MB` source gives approximately `40–120` chunks depending on content/parser quality.
Signed test outputs link release digest
Production data is forbidden in development
An Analyst cannot approve their own high-risk recommendation
Deployment units never share service identities
Denied rework uses a new run revision, never retroactive approval
Orchestrator has no direct DB credentials
Commit case mutations, approval decisions and outbox inserts in one ACID transaction.
If dependency unavailable, return documented retryable error or persisted asynchronous operation identifier, never ambiguous success.
Reset scoped pool variables after every transaction, including failures.
Evaluation uses `1,200` synthetic permission-controlled cases with expected citations/outcomes
encryption-key isolation/rotation tradeoff must be resolved before enterprise general availability.
Audit IDs, time window, blast radius, quality effect, preventative action
Transient faults use bounded exponential backoff/jitter/per-dependency circuit breakers.

Out of scope: Physical automation, irreversible financial transactions, foundation-model fine-tuning, unrestricted browsing, agent administrative cloud permissions and application-hosted GPU inference.
Compare source fingerprints/indexed versions and run denied-access probes before incident closure.
reset pooled scoped variables after every transaction, including failures.
Case `If-Match` conflict returns `409 CASE_VERSION_CONFLICT` with current revision
One audit record per accepted transition
routine spend anomaly creates owner/threshold ticket
cursor passes only durable preceding outcomes.
Both Approve/Reject disabled until required fields complete.

Register classifications remain exact scoped references: `Owner aggregate / UUIDv7 + tenant scope`, `Immutable derivative / SHA-256 source/ revision`, `Policy-bound control / Actor and role predicate`, `Operational ledger / Event ID + trace context`.
Delivery failure cannot roll back internal case transition.
